title: A student from my group joins Kyushu University on the JST LOTUS (Basic) Program.
body: Selected by the Japan Science and Technology Agency (JST) for LOTUS Basic, its India–Japan programme for young researchers, the student opens a research collaboration with Kyushu University, extending the India and Japan ties that began during my years at Keio.

title: ANCIRS, a denoising communication system for the School of Artillery, Nashik
body: Shinkai-Labs is developing ANCIRS, an AI denoising communication system, for the School of Artillery, Devlali, Nashik.

title: Session Chair, IEEE EMBC 2026, Toronto

title: IEEE ComSoc Travel Grant for ICC 2026, Glasgow
